integrity: The proof is unbounded and exhaustive within its stated domain: the divisor interval \(r<\beta(pqr)<qr\) leaves only two possible divisors, \(pq\) and \(pr\), and each possibility is solved exactly. The attached computation is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to squarefree integers with exactly three distinct prime factors. It does not classify nonsquarefree solutions or solutions with four or more distinct prime factors, and it makes no infinitude claim for either parametrized prime branch.
title: Squarefree three-prime numbers divisible by their prime-factor sum
